command:
set -eu
printf "== mobile log directory ==\n"
ls -lt /var/jb/var/mobile | head -35
printf "== GUI error log previous ==\n"
tail -120 /var/jb/var/mobile/WindowServer.err.previous 2>&1 || true
printf "== startup-related files ==\n"
find /var/jb/var/mobile -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname "*gui*log*" -o -iname "*startup*log*" -o -iname "*windowserver*" -o -iname "*rootfs*log*" \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -80
printf "== current launch jobs ==\n"
launchctl print system/com.macwsguide.host 2>&1 | head -100 || true
printf "== rootfs product version ==\n"
/var/jb/usr/bin/plutil -p /var/mnt/rootfs/System/Library/CoreServices/SystemVersion.plist 2>&1 | head -30 || true
